verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents native tool/function calling, where the model requests functions the application defines. The console Playground explicitly supports testing tool/function calling, and Structured Outputs adds JSON-schema-constrained responses. However, nothing in the pack documents parallel tool calls, multi-step agent-loop handling, or hands-on proof that tool calling is reliable on open models. missing for 10: documented parallel tool calls, documented multi-step/agentic tool-use loops, independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-call fidelity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking

citations.quote: Tool calling, also known as tool use or function calling, lets a model request functions that your application defines.
test tool/function calling, and tune parameters, then export a working request to code when you're ready.
Structured Outputs constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process generated data reliably.
